 California Golden Bears Coming off its roughest game of the season, Cal tries to get back on track against an NC State team whose coach was fired a day after losing at Stanford.
--> Coming off its roughest game of the season, Cal tries to get back on track against an NC State team whose coach was fired a day after losing at Stanford.
 The Bears (3-5, 2-3 ACC) and Wolfpack (3-4, 1-3) kick off at 9 a.m. PT on Saturday in Raleigh, NC.
--> The Bears (3-5, 2-3 ACC) and Wolfpack (3-4, 1-3) kick off at 9 a.m. PT on Saturday in Raleigh, NC.
 Cal is trying to avoid for a third straight loss for the first time since 2024, when the Bears lost four in a row on the way to a 6-7 record. The Bears lost 59-20 at SMU last week, outscored 42-0 in the second half.
--> Cal is trying to avoid for a third straight loss for the first time since 2024, when the Bears lost four in a row on the way to a 6-7 record. The Bears lost 59-20 at SMU last week, outscored 42-0 in the second half.
 NC State also has its past two games, including a 31-28 defeat at Stanford. That led to Dan Doeran being dismissed the next day. The Wolfpack hasn't lost three in a row since closing out the 2019 campaign with six straight defeats.
--> NC State also has its past two games, including a 31-28 defeat at Stanford. That led to Dan Doeran being dismissed the next day. The Wolfpack hasn't lost three in a row since closing out the 2019 campaign with six straight defeats.
